recipe.name: Node.js app
evidence: Scripts: build, build:watch, dev, lint, lint:fix, test, prepublishOnly

Start phase boots a real n8n in Docker with this package installed and asserts n8n registers the Composio node and its tool variant, then serves health on port 5699. It needs docker only; no Composio key is required.
The live phase of the start script (calling Composio with a consumer key) is skipped unless COMPOSIO_CONSUMER_KEY is set, so no credential is ever needed in the harness or in this repository.

readinessPath is n8n's liveness endpoint /healthz. /healthz/readiness only turns 200 once the database is connected and migrated, and the start script itself waits for /healthz/readiness before installing the package.
Set PKG_SPEC=@steprotech/n8n-nodes-composio to make the start script install the published package by name from the registry instead of the locally packed tarball.
For build and test only, run: hermes verify --json --skip-start
